about: Matching counts repeats, note by note. idea-harrow-point holds the ferry line twice and the handled list holds it once for that note: the first occurrence (by line order) is handled, the second, under Work, is new work. A handled entry with the same text for brain-dump.md doesn't count toward idea-harrow-point. The pub line appears twice and is handled twice for the note: neither is new. The Brain Dump doc's own ferry line is handled. b1 holds one whole-note piece with the second ferry line.
